units: physical pixels at 100 percent; never infer service pack or DPI from a web thumbnail
status: partial implementation targets, not a pixel-perfect certification
rights: No Microsoft or Apple screenshot, system bitmap, font, msstyles, logo or icon is included. Public pages are reading references. Screenshot downloads/crops require a lawful analysis source; no new third-party bitmap is retained by this change.

comparison.policy: Compare identical-size raw crops without resizing, font masks, hidden pixels or tolerance changes. Report MAE RGB, maximum channel error and changed-pixel count. Component fixtures are actual PollyUI renders, not native Linux desktop captures.
comparison.fullScene: not measured: no certified six-system raw capture pack and no running Linux compositor in the available host
